sample_1.prompt: A young professional woman smiling warmly at her laptop screen, which displays a polished social media profile page with her photo and thousands of followers. She sits in a bright, modern apartment with soft natural light streaming through large windows. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: A seasoned detective in a dimly lit office, carefully pinning photographs, maps, and handwritten notes to a large corkboard, methodically building a criminal profile. A single desk lamp casts dramatic noir-style lighting across the cluttered desk. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, cool dramatic tones, cinematic composition.

sample_3.prompt: A confident group of business executives gathered around a sleek conference table in a modern glass-walled office overlooking an Asian city skyline at dusk. They study charts and presentations about market expansion strategy, gesturing toward the cityscape. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, blue and gold tones, cinematic wide composition.
